Name: Dresser Sorter
Author: idermailer
Description:
[b][size=4]What does this mod do?[/size][/b]
This mode make items in your dresser to be sorted by [u]display name[/u] by default.
For dyeable clothing, they can be sorted by color(by hue), and for rings, combined rings can be prioritized.

[size=4][b]Is this compatible with[/b] [/size][size=4]([/size][size=3]Mod Name here[/size][size=4])[/size][size=4][b]?[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23359]Customize Dresser[/url]: I've done some testing, but it's not entirely guaranteed. Please set [b]SortAdditionalCategories[/b] true in config.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24194]More Dresser Variety[/url]: I haven't tested for it, but I think this mod is compatible as it seems to have a similar function to Customize Dresser. Please set [b]SortAdditionalCategories[/b] true in config too.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15928]Identifiable Combined Rings[/url]: I haven't tested it, but [i]if that mod works[/i] in SV 1.6, I think it won't have much of an impact and will be compatible.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8801]Combine Many Rings[/url]: I wrote the code with that mod in mind, but I can't guarantee that there will be no problems.

[b][size=4]Does this mod work well in languages other than English?[/size][/b]
[size=5]Of course.[/size]

--------
Uses SMAPI, uses Harmony.
Source code is [url=https://github.com/idermailer/DresserSorter]here[/url]
